Name: JP's Artdew Valley Vol VIII - Strikers 1945
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][b][i][color=#00ffff][u][center]Artdew Valley Vol VIII[/center][/u][/color][/i][/b][/size]

[size=5][i][b][color=#ff00ff]Because there must be someone out there who remembers this game... Anyone?... Hello?... Hellooooo?...[/color][/b][/i][/size]


[i][size=4][b]This mod consists of 12 volumes so far, this being the eighth of them. This volume focuses on adding 36 [/b][i][b]models of the main planes from the arcade videogame saga "Strikers 1945/99".[/b]
[/i][/size][/i]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]You can get all these models at [color=#00ff00]Robin[/color][color=#00ff00]'s shop[/color] for a modest price of 500g up to 1000g each. It depends on the size.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]You will find at least 8 models in the store per season, so you could get them all in a year.[/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=4][b][/b][/size][/font][*][font=Georgia][size=4]The 1945 Planes will have a small animation in which they move their propellers, and during the night they will stop the propellers and turn on the lights and a flashing light. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]The 1999 Planes, more modern, alternate their lights. During the night they also turn on their lights and a flashing light. [/size][/font]
[/list]

[size=5][b][i][color=#ff00ff]They are simple decorations with no other use or functionality, an unlocked memory if there is anyone who played these games back in the day. [/color]

[/i][/b][/size][i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u][b]Translations[/b][/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000][b]you don't need to ask my permission[/b][/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size][b][i]
